pulls.author: pf0n
pulls.body_excerpt: There's a significant performance improvement for p100 if GenShen goes into a degenerated cycle instead of a full GC for humongous allocation failure. The collector can still go into a full GC if it reaches a certain amount of consecutive degenerated cycles. We're only removing the path where it goes into a full GC immediately after humongous allocation failure. The measurement here is the "average p100 for individual latency" in microseconds. Before this change, average p100 was 2.2 seconds and now it's 124ms.
